gap: No result ChatGPT got states today's maker-store prices for the whole category: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 is $899 on bluettipower.com (Outage Authority quoted $1,399 on Nov 3), the cheapest in-stock 3.5 kWh-class units are Growatt HELIOS 3600 at $1,589 and EcoFlow DELTA Pro at $1,799, and ALLPOWERS R4000 and BLUETTI AC200L are sold out.
standout_why: Outage Authority (cited) already has a runtime table, furnace wattages from LBNL/NRC, and three prices dated Nov 3 (C2000 Gen 2 $999.99, Elite 200 v2 $1,399, DELTA Pro 3 $2,799); it has no stock status, no Growatt/Jackery/ALLPOWERS/original DELTA Pro prices, and its Elite 200 V2 price is $500 stale. PreparedStates names no models or prices. The Reliance TF PDF (cited) is a wiring sheet with no products. Anker's F3800 FAQ adds a maker line on inlet-box neutral/ground that Outage Authority says it could not find in manuals.
decides: At $899 the Elite 200 V2 (2,073.6 Wh, 2,600 W) is now about $0.43/Wh, undercutting the Anker C2000 Gen 2's $0.49/Wh that Outage Authority used to rank it first in the 2 kWh class, so the 2 kWh pick flips to BLUETTI; above 3 kWh the in-stock choice today is Elite 300 at $1,199 (3,014 Wh) or Growatt HELIOS 3600 at $1,589 (3,686 Wh, TT-30, 15 ms EPS), because R4000 and AC200L cannot be bought and the DELTA Pro 3 price could not be re-read today.

findings.label: Price, maker store
findings.note: Shopify storefront via storecheck. 3,014.4 Wh / 2,400 W. Page-method hours: 3,014 × 0.85 / 240 W ≈ 10.7 h PSC, ≈ 21 h ECM. Loses on: 2,400 W, 120 V only, no 30 A outlet, so it is a cord-to-furnace-switch unit, not an inlet-box unit.

findings.label: Price, maker store
findings.source_title: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 Portable Power Station | 2,600W 2,073.6Wh
findings.note: Outage Authority read $1,399 on 2026-11-03; today $899 = $0.43/Wh. Hours: 2,073.6 × 0.85 / 240 ≈ 7.3 h PSC, ≈ 14.7 h ECM. Loses on: not expandable (Outage Authority citing BLUETTI support), so a two-night outage needs a second unit.

findings.label: Price and stock, maker store
findings.note: All AC200L bundles also show available: false. Loses on: cannot be bought today; same price as the newer Elite 200 V2 with less output (2,400 W vs 2,600 W).

findings.label: Price, maker store
findings.note: 3,686 Wh, 3,600 W, TT-30 outlet, 15 ms EPS, 240 V only by paralleling two units ($139 Double Voltage Power Hub with two L14-30). Hours: 3,686 × 0.85 / 240 ≈ 13 h PSC, ≈ 26 h ECM. Loses on: single unit is 120 V, so an L14-30 inlet box needs two units plus the hub.

findings.label: Stock and inlet-box neutral/ground note, maker page
findings.value: Sold Out, no price shown; FAQ: when powering a transfer switch or inlet box through the 240 V port, 'check and confirm that the neutral and ground wires of the inlet box or transfer switch are properly connected'
